stories.headline: AI credit fears push tech default costs higher
stories.summary: Default-insurance costs for major US tech firms hit records as investors question debt-funded AI spending. CoreWeave's market-implied five-year default risk reached nearly 63%; that is a market signal, not a forecast.

stories.headline: Cohere moves to buy cybersecurity startup AISLE
stories.summary: Cohere signed a letter of intent to acquire AISLE, adding AI-based vulnerability detection to the group it is forming with Aleph Alpha. Deal terms were not disclosed, and completion has not been announced.

stories.headline: US military weighs larger bomb in Iran plans
stories.summary: CNN reports that US contingency plans for renewed Iran strikes could include the GBU-43/B bomb against energy or nuclear sites. No strike has been ordered, questions remain about effectiveness, and Reuters could not verify the report.

stories.headline: Ukraine resumes strikes on Russian refineries
stories.summary: President Zelenskiy said Ukraine would resume refinery attacks after concluding Russia had abandoned an energy ceasefire. A fire hit the Ryazan refinery; Russia and Ukraine continue giving competing accounts of the truce.

stories.headline: Supreme Court lets FCC ad-rate policy continue
stories.summary: The Supreme Court let the FCC avoid a pre-midterm deadline to rule on a Democratic challenge to discounted ad rates for party committees. The underlying case remains unresolved; two liberal justices would have denied the stay.
